system.description:
Corrupt Thoughts – Mentally Compromised.

This special condition is treated as a Mental Condition.

A Mentally Compromised creature finds it difficult to shut out psychic intrusion. They treat a failure as a Critical failure vs Genjutsu with the Tactile keyword. The first time this effect occurs, this condition ends.

Additionally, once per turn, when a Mentally Compromised creature makes a Concentration check to maintain concentration on a jutsu, they must first spend 4 Chakra to make the check, if they choose not to, they immediately lose concentration as if they failed the check. This effect increases in strength at 6th level, becoming 6 Chakra. This boost occurs again at 10th (8), 14th (10) and 18th (12) levels.

Enhanced Effect (Lvl 10). A Mentally Compromised creature radiates a 15ft radius aura of madness. The first time each turn a creature allied to it within its madness aura casts a Jutsu, they must roll a DC 11 Flat Check. On a failure, the Genjutsu Specialist can cause the failing creatures Jutsu to be Interrupted as it falls into a short psychotic break. Once a creature is interrupted in this way, this condition ends.
system.summary: A failed save against a Tactile Genjutsu is a critical failure (then it ends); Concentration checks first cost chakra (4, more by the Genjutsu Specialist's level); at 10th, an aura of madness.

rules.text: A failure against a Genjutsu with the Tactile keyword counts as a critical failure; the first time that happens, this condition ends.
Once per turn, before a Concentration check: spend chakra to make it (4; 6 at the Genjutsu Specialist's 6th level, 8 at 10th, 10 at 14th, 12 at 18th) or lose concentration.

Enhanced (Genjutsu Specialist 10th, Disruptive Psyche): a 15-foot aura of madness. An ally of it in the aura casting its first jutsu each turn rolls a DC 11 flat check; on a failure the Genjutsu Specialist can Interrupt the jutsu, and this condition ends.
